shortDescription: Add or remove multiple LDAP attribute values.

options.name: attributes
options.description: The attribute(s) and value(s) to add or remove. The complex argument format is required in order to pass a list of strings (see examples).

options.name: bind_dn
options.description: A DN to bind with. If this is omitted, we'll try a SASL bind with the EXTERNAL mechanism. If this is blank, we'll use an anonymous bind.

options.name: bind_pw
options.description: The password to use with I(bind_dn).

options.name: dn
options.description: The DN of the entry to modify.

options.name: ordered
options.description: If C(yes), prepend list values with X-ORDERED index numbers in all attributes specified in the current task. This is useful mostly with I(olcAccess) attribute to easily manage LDAP Access Control Lists.

options.name: server_uri
options.description: A URI to the LDAP server. The default value lets the underlying LDAP client library look for a UNIX domain socket in its default location.

options.name: start_tls
options.description: If true, we'll use the START_TLS LDAP extension.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the attribute values. If C(present), all given values will be added if they're missing. If C(absent), all given values will be removed if present. If C(exact), the set of values will be forced to exactly those provided and no others. If I(state=exact) and I(value) is empty, all values for this attribute will be removed.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on sites using self-signed certificates.
